title: Adversarial Prompts Degrade Honest Uncertainty Reporting: Calibration Under Attack

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Confidence-based filtering is used in safety pipelines. If adversarial attacks inflate confidence alongside harmful output, a concrete safety net fails. Clear and practical chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires adversarial prompt generation and confidence extraction (verbalized or logit-based). Calibration curve computation is standard statistics. The adversarial prompt generation is the main barrier.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused question: do adversarial attacks systematically inflate confidence? Single experiment with clear metric (calibration shift). Can use pre-generated adversarial prompts. Fits 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
